title: In Brief: UT-Led Fusion Research Team Wins Google.org AI Award
hook_text: AI is accelerating fusion energy research.
script:
Google.org selected a University of Texas team for its AI for Science grant.
They are part of a massive thirty-six million dollar funding program.
Principal investigator Joshua Burby leads this specific research team.
The award supports researchers using AI to address critical scientific challenges.
This project specifically targets advanced fusion energy development.
The funding helps them accelerate computational modeling for energy systems.
Google.org chose this UT group out of many global applicants.
Would you trust AI to solve our clean energy crisis?
